name: Exp_NRatioSign
summary: This EA trades based on the NRatioSign custom indicator signals, which is a normalized ratio oscillator with configurable smoothing and price inputs. It opens buy positions when the indicator's upper buffer signals and sell positions when the lower buffer signals, with separate controls for entry and exit. The EA supports multiple money management modes and fixed stop loss/take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于NRatioSign自定义指标信号进行交易，NRatioSign是一个带可配置平滑和价格输入的归一化比率振荡器。当指标上轨发出信号时开多仓，下轨发出信号时开空仓，入场和出场可独立控制。支持多种资金管理模式和固定止损/止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于NRatioSign指标的动量信号，该指标通过平滑算法对价格比率进行归一化处理，产生超买超卖信号。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上出现非零且非空值时，触发买入开仓和卖出平仓；当下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）出现有效信号时，触发卖出开仓和买入平仓。出场条件包括：固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向指标信号触发的平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于自由保证金、余额、减亏损自由保证金、减亏损余额的比例计算，以及固定手数。EA还具有反向信号扫描机制——当开仓和平仓同时启用但当前K线未产生平仓信号时，会向后遍历历史K线寻找最近的反向平仓信号，以减少持仓时间。整体策略属于信号驱动的系统化交易，依赖单一指标的多参数配置。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on momentum signals from the NRatioSign indicator, which normalizes price ratios through configurable smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, etc.) to generate overbought/oversold signals. Entry conditions: when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) shows a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar, it triggers buy entry and sell close; when the lower buffer (buffer 0) shows a valid signal, it triggers sell entry and buy close. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus reverse indicator signal closes. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, balance, balance minus loss, free margin minus loss, or fixed lot size. The EA also features a reverse signal scanning mechanism — when both open and close flags are enabled but no close signal appears on the current bar, it scans backward through historical bars to find the nearest reverse close signal, reducing position holding time. The overall strategy is a signal-driven systematic trading approach relying on a single indicator with extensive parameter configuration.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例（占保证金/余额的百分比）

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/减亏损等）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: free margin/balance/minus loss

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（反向信号平卖单）
parameters.description_en: Allow buy close (reverse signal closes sell orders)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（反向信号平买单）
parameters.description_en: Allow sell close (reverse signal closes buy orders)

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 信号算法模式（入场/出场）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前，1=前一根）

pros: 灵活的资金管理模式，支持5种仓位计算方式，适应不同风险偏好
入场和出场逻辑完全解耦，可通过布尔参数独立控制买卖的开仓和平仓
具有反向信号历史扫描机制，在当前K线无平仓信号时向后搜索，减少不必要的持仓时间
支持多种平滑算法和价格类型，策略可调性强
使用新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复交易
pros_en: Flexible money management with 5 position sizing modes to suit different risk preferences
Entry and exit logic fully decoupled — buy/sell open/close independently controllable via boolean inputs
Reverse signal history scanning mechanism searches backward when no close signal on current bar, reducing unnecessary position holding time
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms and price types, providing strong strategy tunability
New bar detection prevents repeated trading within the same bar
cons: 依赖单一自定义指标NRatioSign，指标源码不可见，无法审计其内部逻辑
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值偏大，对于小周期交易风险过高
反向信号历史扫描可能遍历大量K线，在指标缓冲区较大时影响性能
无点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
无持仓检查，可能重复开仓导致仓位叠加
缺少时间过滤和交易日限制，可能在低流动性时段交易
cons_en: Relies on a single custom NRatioSign indicator whose source is not visible, making internal logic unauditable
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, posing high risk for smaller timeframe trading
Reverse signal history scanning may iterate through many bars, potentially degrading performance with large indicator buffers
No spread filter — could execute trades at disadvantageous prices in high-spread environments
No position check before opening — risk of duplicate entries stacking positions
Lacks time filter and trading day restrictions, may trade during low liquidity sessions
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，在开仓前确认同方向无已持仓，避免重复开仓
增加点差过滤和时间过滤，避免高点差和低流动性时段的不利成交
优化反向信号扫描性能，限制最大回扫K线数量
添加移动止损或追踪止损功能，保护已有利润
improvements_en: Add position check logic before opening — verify no existing same-direction position to prevent duplicate entries
Add spread filter and time filter to avoid unfavorable fills during high-spread and low-liquidity sessions
Optimize reverse signal scanning performance by limiting the maximum number of bars to scan backward
Add trailing stop functionality to protect accumulated profits

risk_points: 无持仓检查，可能同方向重复开仓导致仓位意外叠加
默认止损1000点/止盈2000点数值偏大，小账户风险敞口过高
依赖不可审计的自定义指标，指标计算逻辑存在黑箱风险
无点差过滤和交易时间限制，可能在不利条件下执行交易
risk_points_en: No position check before opening — risk of same-direction duplicate entries causing unintended position stacking
Default SL/TP of 1000/2000 points are large, creating excessive risk exposure for small accounts
Depends on unauditable custom indicator — black-box risk in indicator calculation logic
No spread filter or trading time restrictions — may execute under unfavorable conditions
